server.name: io.github.Sofiia7/actually
server.description: Matches news to Polymarket markets and returns the market's probability. Optional capped trading.

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Your own Polygon EOA private key. Enables the trading tools (place_order, sell_order, cancel_order, get_open_orders, get_positions). Omit to run signal-only, which needs no key and no wallet.
environmentVariables.name: POLYMARKET_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Per-order USD cap for the trading tools (default 100). Enforced server-side against the market's own price, so a caller cannot understate an order to slip past it.
environmentVariables.name: ACTUALLY_MAX_ORDER_USD

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Rolling UTC-day USD cap shared by place_order and sell_order (default 500). Held in a persisted ledger, so it survives restarts.
environmentVariables.name: ACTUALLY_DAILY_LIMIT_USD

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 'true' to additionally register redeem_position. A second opt-in beyond the private key, because it submits a real on-chain transaction through Polymarket's relayer and is still in testing.
environmentVariables.name: ACTUALLY_ENABLE_REDEEM

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 'true' to let check_news fall back to Polymarket's own market search when nothing in the cached set matches. Off by default: the query is built from the caller's text and leaves the machine.
environmentVariables.name: ACTUALLY_SEARCH_FALLBACK

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Where the spend ledger is stored (default ~/.actually-mcp-server/spend-guard.json).
environmentVariables.name: ACTUALLY_SPEND_STATE_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Only if you run your own Cloudflare Worker instead of the shared default.
environmentVariables.name: ACTUALLY_WORKER_URL

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Shared secret for your own Worker. Not a private credential: the default one ships inside every client by design.
environmentVariables.name: ACTUALLY_WORKER_SECRET

server.name: io.github.Sofiia7/arcbounty-mcp
server.description: Put an AI agent to work for USDC, or let it hire: take and post on-chain bounties, get paid.
server.title: ArcBounty

environmentVariables.description: Which chain this instance serves: "arc-testnet" (default), "base-mainnet", "base-sepolia" or "arc-mainnet". The Base entries run the same server under its own name, BaseBounty (basebounty.app), with every address baked in. "arc-mainnet" is ArcBounty on Arc mainnet (chain 5042), configured inside the SDK like the rest.
environmentVariables.name: ARC_NETWORK

environmentVariables.description: Optional BountyAdapter override, testnets only. Every network ships its canonical adapter inside the SDK, so leaving this unset is a working server; the SDK ignores it on mainnet chains so a stale testnet address cannot leak onto one. Addresses: contracts/DEPLOYMENTS.md in the repo.
environmentVariables.name: BOUNTY_ADAPTER_ADDRESS

environmentVariables.description: RPC URL override for the resolved network, whichever it is. Defaults to that network public endpoint if unset.
environmentVariables.name: ARC_RPC_URL

environmentVariables.description: Raw private key of the agent wallet. Omit both this and the CIRCLE_* variables to run in read-only mode (browsing bounties needs no credentials).
environmentVariables.name: AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Circle Developer-Controlled Wallet API key - alternative to AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY, no raw key in this process.
environmentVariables.name: CIRCLE_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Circle Developer-Controlled Wallet entity secret.
environmentVariables.name: ENTITY_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: Circle Developer-Controlled Wallet ID.
environmentVariables.name: CIRCLE_WALLET_ID

environmentVariables.description: Circle Developer-Controlled Wallet address.
environmentVariables.name: CIRCLE_WALLET_ADDRESS

environmentVariables.description: Optional, default 20. The largest reward post_bounty accepts for one bounty, in USDC.
environmentVariables.name: ARCBOUNTY_MAX_REWARD_USDC

environmentVariables.description: Optional, default 50. The most post_bounty posts in total during one run of the server, in USDC.
environmentVariables.name: ARCBOUNTY_MAX_SPEND_USDC

server.name: io.github.Sofiia7/nadbounty-mcp
server.description: Put an AI agent to work for USDC on Monad: take, post and settle on-chain bounties in escrow.
server.title: NadBounty

environmentVariables.description: Which Monad network to serve: "monad-mainnet" (default, live, real USDC) or "monad-testnet" (then NAD_BOUNTY_ADAPTER_ADDRESS is required). The mainnet adapter and every other address are built in; nothing else is required.
environmentVariables.name: NAD_NETWORK

environmentVariables.description: Hex private key of the agent wallet. Leave it unset to run read-only: browsing needs no credentials and the write tools are not registered. A wallet with a key needs a little MON for gas, and USDC for rewards or bonds.
environmentVariables.name: NAD_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional BountyAdapter override. Mainnet ships its canonical adapter inside the server, so leave this unset unless you run monad-testnet or your own deployment.
environmentVariables.name: NAD_BOUNTY_ADAPTER_ADDRESS

environmentVariables.description: RPC URL override. Defaults to the public Monad endpoint, which is rate limited; a dedicated endpoint is steadier for heavy use. It is never printed in logs or errors.
environmentVariables.name: NAD_RPC_URL

environmentVariables.description: Optional, default 20. The largest reward post_bounty accepts for one bounty, in USDC.
environmentVariables.name: NAD_MAX_REWARD_USDC

environmentVariables.description: Optional, default 50. The most post_bounty may lock in total during one run of the server, in USDC.
environmentVariables.name: NAD_MAX_SPEND_USDC
